cases.entry_path: launch holla --scenario first-use --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40

cases.disposition_reason: Parity discovery does not paint the words pending, ready, or failed. Reduced motion sets every source done_at to 0 (src/bin/holla/domain/parity.rs), so those stages are separate --motion paused --frame processes (src/bin/holla/main.rs, src/bin/holla/app.rs). Frame 0 shows discovering … · 0 of 9, › stays on Clean IntelliJ, Pull and Run tests are absent, and a docker query is No matches for with Nothing to preview and no selected row. Frame 8 shows discovering … · 5 of 9 and Run tests, Pull is still absent, and › is still Clean IntelliJ. Frame 12 shows the docker Data row unavailable · Cannot connect to the Docker daemon while status is still discovering … · 6 of 9, and › is still Clean IntelliJ. Frame 20 shows discovering git, brew · 7 of 9 and 4 config warnings. The clone row is absent: github.clone is built inside git_items, which returns until source_ready("git") (src/bin/holla/domain/catalog.rs), and git finishes at tick 40. Frame 40 shows ! docker, github unavailable. Pull is present above Clean IntelliJ and its line has no ›; › is still Clean IntelliJ. On the reduced surface every source is already finished, so › starts on Pull. Typing "cargo " selects cargo test. Pasting clippy selects cargo clippy. One backspace leaves the query cargo clipp. Esc restores › Pull. Typing zzzz-no-such-action shows No matches for and Nothing to preview, with no selected item row. Enter leaves that screen: activate_current returns Consumed when current() is None (src/bin/holla/screens/finder.rs), so the previous result does not run. The hint still says Enter Run. Esc restores the open surface. That surface is captured at 120×40, then at 80×24, and only then does the terminal return to 120×40.
cases.action_sequence: Show pending, ready, failed, and unavailable discovery. Type, paste, backspace, and clear the query.
cases.expected_results: The selected identity stays while order changes. Empty results have no runnable row.
cases.forbidden_effects: Enter on an empty result runs the previous result.
